measure: derived from existing first-run traces; descriptive, not pre-registered

link_definitions.reply_to_interaction: Inbound reply stored as an interaction event with its interaction_id and source nudge_id
link_definitions.interaction_to_decision: Interaction decision persisted with a decision_id that carries the same interaction_id
link_definitions.decision_to_envelope: Decision behaviour_key resolves to an approved envelope carrying the taxonomy triple
link_definitions.policy_to_audit: Model recommendation and policy outcome persisted as separate rows sharing the evaluation_key
link_definitions.schedule_change_to_decision: Changed recurring schedule rows name the persisted applied policy decision that changed them
link_definitions.next_message_to_decision: Prepared next message names a persisted adaptation decision
link_definitions.next_message_to_prescription: Prepared next message resolves to an active prescription
link_definitions.tracked_link_to_next_message: Tracked media link names the prepared next message
